<template>
  <v-card
    class="mx-auto"
    max-width="448"
  >
    <v-layout>
      <v-app-bar
      color="white"
      >
        <template v-slot:prepend>
          <v-img src="@/assets/logo.png" :width="200" class="custom-v-img"></v-img>
        </template>
    
        <v-spacer></v-spacer>
    
        <v-btn icon @click="value = !value">
          <v-icon>mdi-account</v-icon>
        </v-btn>
        <v-btn v-show="value" @click="logout">
          Sair
        </v-btn>
      </v-app-bar>

      <v-main>
        <v-container fluid>
         
        </v-container>
      </v-main>
    </v-layout>
  </v-card>

<v-container>
  <v-card class="mx-auto my-10" color="grey-lighten-3">
    
  </v-card>
  
   
</v-container>
</template>

<script>
export default {
  name: 'DashboardView',
  data() {
    return {
      value: false
    }
  },
  methods: {
    logout() {
      localStorage.removeItem('AUTH_TOKEN');
      this.$router.push(this.$route.query.redirect || '/login');
    }
  }
}

</script>

<style>
.custom-title {
  font-size: 29px;
  font-weight: 900;
}

.custom-subtitle {
  font-size: 19px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: black !important;
}

.custom-v-card-iframe {
  height: 60vh;
}

.custom-iframe {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}
</style>
